t: A free self-paced Google course on machine learning with Python exercises in the browser.
steps: Open the Machine Learning Crash Course in a browser.
Check that students know Python basics, algebra, and some statistics.
Ask IT to confirm that Colab and TensorFlow Playground are open on school networks.
Decide which students will use a Google account.
Work through the first module yourself.
Assign one module at a time.
Meet weekly to discuss the exercises.
